content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-45. - Ordinance to order work done.
content.summary:
The ordinance creating a district, as amended, if amended, shall order the work to
               be done as provided in this article.
(Code 1981, § 27-46; Ord. No. 551, § 17(D), 5-14-1964)
